alt: Several black DDR5 G.Skill Trident Z5 CK Series memory sticks arranged in a row on a dark surface, their angular heat spreaders gleaming
story: On November 2, 2026, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said on a podcast that it is 'quite terrible' for everyone to hold a share of the world's limited DRAM supply in personal computers where it sits idle most of the time, arguing all memory should be pooled in AI data centers — where OpenAI can charge you to use it.
why_funny: The CEO of a company that sells cloud AI subscriptions earnestly told the world that your personal RAM is a problem he would like to solve personally — by holding all of it, in his servers, for a monthly fee.
